docs.title: LexAgent
docs.text: Grounded rental-law reasoning over Texas Property Code Chapter 92 and California Civil Code §§1940–1954, plus a seeded synthetic precedent corpus.

docs.title: What it does
docs.text: LexAgent answers landlord–tenant legal questions by retrieving relevant statute sections and synthetic precedents, reasoning over them with explicit citations, and verifying those citations before returning an answer. If the question is outside the supported jurisdictions or the corpus is insufficient, it refuses rather than hallucinating.

docs.title: Status
docs.text: Phase 0 walking skeleton is complete: FastAPI backend, trivial echo graph, SSE streaming, Next.js frontend, and the full A2-derived toolchain.

docs.title: Data pipeline
docs.text:
1. data/seed_statutes.py extracts statute sections from public-domain TX and CA landlord–tenant law.
  2. data/seed_precedents.py generates synthetic case summaries and outcomes.
  3. data/build_index.py embeds both corpora into Qdrant collections for retrieval.

docs.title: Architecture overview
docs.text:
LexAgent follows the same layered architecture as the portfolio's other agents:

  • src/lexagent/api/ — FastAPI routes, SSE streaming, middleware, SQLite run persistence, and the async query executor.
  • src/lexagent/graph/ — LangGraph state machine, nodes, edges, chains, agents.
  • src/lexagent/tools/ — Tools the agent can call.
  • src/lexagent/retrieval/ — Qdrant-backed vector retrieval and a keyword-based local corpus store for statutes and precedents.
  • src/lexagent/schemas/ — Domain state and output models.
  • src/lexagent/prompts/ — Prompt templates.
  • evals/ — Retrieval-recall evals (keyword vs semantic) and an LLM-judged answer eval (make eval-answers).

docs.title: State and flow
docs.text:
The graph state tracks the user's question, retrieved sources, drafted answer, citation-verification results, and final outcome. The high-level flow is:

graph TD
    A[Receive question] --> B{In scope?}
    B -->|no| C[Refuse]
    B -->|yes| D[Retrieve statutes]
    D --> E[Retrieve precedents]
    E --> F[Draft answer]
    F --> G{Verify citations}
    G -->|fail| E
    G -->|pass| H[Return answer]

docs.title: Tools
docs.text:
Planned tools for the full reasoning loop:

  • search_statutes — semantic + keyword search over the statute corpus.
  • search_precedents — semantic search over synthetic case summaries.
  • verify_citation — confirm a cited source exists in the retrieved corpora.
  • ask_clarification — request more facts from the user.

docs.title: Grounding
docs.text: LexAgent's answers must be traceable to a statute section or a synthetic precedent. Before an answer is returned, a citation verifier checks that every cited source was actually retrieved. If a citation is missing or malformed, the loop reroutes back to retrieval rather than publishing an ungrounded answer.

docs.title: In plain language
docs.text:
LexAgent is a legal-research assistant for a narrow domain: landlord–tenant law in Texas and California. You ask a question in plain English; it answers with citations to the statute or to synthetic precedent summaries, and it shows you the reasoning path that led to the answer.

It is not a lawyer. It refuses questions outside its scope and tells you when its sources are insufficient.

docs.title: The reasoning loop
docs.text:
1. Understand the question and the jurisdictions involved.
  2. Retrieve relevant statute sections from both the TX and CA corpora.
  3. Retrieve relevant synthetic precedent summaries.
  4. Reason and draft an answer with inline citations.
  5. Verify that every cited statute section or case actually exists in the retrieved corpus.
  6. Return the answer, or refuse / request clarification if verification fails or the question is out of scope.

docs.title: What it won't do
docs.text:
• Answer questions outside landlord–tenant law or outside TX and CA.
  • Provide legal advice; it returns research-oriented summaries only.
  • Rely on uncited sources. If the corpus does not cover the question, it refuses or abstains.
